2. Jaleustrophos, the Tomb of the Agile. Teleports players by Simon Templeton's camp.
3. Jaldraocht, the Tomb of Magic. Teleports players to the pyramid entrance.

4. Jaltevas, the Tomb of the Father. Teleports players next to the obelisk in the necropolis. Players must commune with the obelisk with the sceptre in your inventory before being able to teleport here. The sceptre does not need to be charged for communing to unlock the teleport.
Ghorrock Dungeon (requires using the frozen tablet on the ring)
The Scar (requires using the scarred tablet on the ring)
Lassar Undercity palace (requires using the sirenic tablet on the ring)

The Stranglewood temple entrance (requires using the strangled tablet on the ring). This will teleport you to a potentially DANGEROUS area as there may be multiple Strangled standing at the Pyramid top.

A small island in the middle of some lava on Mount Karuulm.
Atop the small plateau east of Mount Quidamortem. This is the only location with interactable objects on it (dead trees).
An island off the south-east coast of Hosidius.
An island north-east of the Fishing Hamlet, north of Arceuus.
1. Xeric's Lookout, at its entrance south-east of Shayzien.
2. Xeric's Glade, by the magic trees north-east of the Hosidius farming patch.
3. Xeric's Inferno, at the lovakite furnace in the centre of Lovakengj
4. Xeric's Heart, next to the statue at Kourend Castle.
5. Xeric's Honour, at the summit of Mount Quidamortem. Players must use an ancient tablet on the talisman before being able to teleport here.
